CSS keyframes on box-shadow/background-color (parsed but not rendered by this GTK version); only opacity keyframes are reliable

drawer.type: Gtk.Fixed child translation inside a fixed, always-mapped window
drawer.note: The layer surface never moves or unmaps; a 16ms timer translates the shell by integer pixels inside a Gtk.Fixed. Hidden state keeps the shell outside the window and disables input targeting. The timer waits for window map + the first frame tick before starting, so cold starts cannot skip the 560ms animation.
